# Plugin.Maui.BluetoothSerial

Classic Bluetooth SPP / RFCOMM serial session for .NET MAUI.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.BluetoothSerial
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BluetoothSerial
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-bluetooth-serial/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android SPP first-class. iOS is MFi / ExternalAccessory only.

## Current release

1.0.1. Host apps must declare Android and iOS permissions listed in the README.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BluetoothSerial

Registration: `UseBluetoothSerial` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I talk SPP / RFCOMM from MAUI?
- Classic Bluetooth serial, not BLE

## Do not use when

- BLE GATT (use Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager)
- ESC/POS documents (use Plugin.Maui.Printing)
